meta.title: DQ9Recomp — Dragon Quest IX on PC and Android
meta.description: Unofficial native port of Dragon Quest IX for Windows, Linux and Android. Download the launcher, import your ROM, play.
meta.share: Dragon Quest IX, rewritten in Rust for Windows, Linux and Android.

home.game: Dragon Quest IX: Sentinels of the Starry Skies
home.tagline: , rewritten in Rust to run natively on PC and phones. Big screen, gamepad, keyboard or touch — and your adventure logs come with you.

dialogue.line2: This port contains no game data.
dialogue.line3: Bring the ROM from your own cartridge: the launcher takes care of the rest.

download.title: Download
download.windows: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Unzip, then run dq9-runtime.exe.
download.android: 64-bit phones, Android 8 or later. Built-in touch controls.
download.note: No game data is included: each package only holds the engine and its launcher. Previous releases and their notes are on

install.title: Install
install.step1: Grab the package for your system above. On PC, extract it wherever you like: everything stays in that folder.
install.step2After: (or the DQ9Recomp app) and pick the European ROM, dumped from your own cartridge.
install.step3: Graphics, text, music and cutscenes are extracted once and for all on your device. Then it’s the title screen.
install.androidText: The APK doesn’t come from the Play Store: allow your browser to install apps, then open the downloaded file. Play Protect may ask for confirmation: the APK is signed, always with the same key.
install.updatesBefore: The launcher checks for new releases at startup and installs them for you (

progress.detailLanguage: Area and item details are written in French, as in the launcher.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: No. It’s a native engine, written in Rust from a reading of the game’s ARM code: neither emulation nor static recompilation. Hence the high resolution and smoothness.
faq.q2: Why do I need my own ROM?
faq.a2: The project distributes no game data. The launcher checks the ROM (code YDQP), then extracts its assets locally. Any other version is refused with an explanation.
faq.q3: Can I keep my DS save?
faq.a3: Yes: on the launcher’s Adventure Logs page, “Import a DS save” accepts .sav and .dsv files.
faq.a4: Keyboard, gamepad, mouse or touch. Controls can be remapped in the launcher; on Android, a touch gamepad appears in game.
